Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000746": The product catalog lived with the Cinder team from 2025-01-17 until 2025-10-20, when it moved to the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal, Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000714": The notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-09-26.  (about: Cinder, notifier, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000666": Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15.  (about: Boreal, indexer)
- memory_id "1000610": The indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-29.  (about: Cinder, indexer, retention change)
- memory_id "1000584" [constraint]: The indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, full reindex)
- memory_id "1000581": After the cache change, the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000502" [decision]: Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000496": During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000418": The reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change.  (about: reports pipeline, retention change)
- memory_id "1000333" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000330": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000308": The product catalog's request volume halved following the client rollout.  (about: product catalog, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000286": Joined writes in the product catalog were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000273": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000271" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000223" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds as follow-up to INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000220": INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000216": Notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000206": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000196" [decision]: The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28.  (about: Boreal, indexer)
Existing entity names: Boreal, Cinder, product catalog, notifier, client rollout, indexer, retention change, OpenSearch 2.11, full reindex, authentication gateway, INC-2025-017, reports pipeline, Ledger, INC-2025-011, push provider, INC-2025-004
